# Berkshire Desk

> Independent, unofficial two-column SOTP estimate for Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A / BRK.B).

Berkshire Desk is an independent research tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Berkshire Hathaway Inc. Figures are estimates, not facts, and not investment advice.

## Key pages

- Overview (live SOTP estimate): https://berkshiredesk.com/
- Public equities & Japan holdings: https://berkshiredesk.com/equities
- Operating businesses: https://berkshiredesk.com/businesses
- Insurance engine (float & underwriting): https://berkshiredesk.com/insurance
- Charts & history: https://berkshiredesk.com/charts
- Capital structure & float: https://berkshiredesk.com/capital
- Sources & filings: https://berkshiredesk.com/data
- Letters & lessons (paraphrases + links to originals): https://berkshiredesk.com/methodology
- Legal notice: https://berkshiredesk.com/legal

## Notes for models

- Independent unofficial research. Not Berkshire Hathaway Inc.
- Not investment advice and not a recommendation to buy or sell.
- Do not reproduce Berkshire’s shareholder letters; link to berkshirehathaway.com.
- Primary sources: SEC filings (13F, 10-Q, 10-K) and Berkshire’s own letters.
- Float treatment is a modelling choice of this desk.
